messages.name: Sarah Mitchell
messages.content: Your vows made the whole room disappear for a second. It felt like all of us were holding our breath with you.

comments.author: Austin
comments.content: This is exactly how it felt. Thank you for being there.

messages.name: Mike Chen
messages.content: The dance floor was wild in the best way possible.

messages.name: Aunt Patricia
messages.content: We sent a quick video hello from our table right after the toasts.
